title: Wands in tarot: Ace to Five meanings
description: Ace to Five of Wands in tarot: upright and reversed meanings for each card, how they form a story, and how to use them in a tarot spread.

scenes.headline: Wands in tarot: Ace to Five meanings
scenes.caption: The Ace to Five of Wands cover the start of a venture, from the first spark to the friction that follows. Each card has an upright and a reversed meaning.
scenes.vo: The Ace to Five of Wands cover the start of a venture, from the first spark to the friction that follows. Each card has an upright and a reversed meaning.

scenes.headline: Ace of Wands
scenes.caption: Beginnings, inspiration, a spark. In the RWS image a hand emerges from a cloud holding a sprouting wand.

scenes.headline: Two of Wands
scenes.caption: Planning, choice, looking ahead. A figure stands on a battlement holding a small globe, with a wand at either side.
